common.tagline: Your companion for barangay health work.

home.heading: Welcome to BHW Connect
home.body: This is the foundation shell for Phase 1. Features roll out one increment at a time.

privacy.heading: Privacy Notice
privacy.body: The full Data Privacy Act notice ships with the consent flow in a later increment.

login.heading: Log in
login.body: Use the username and password your admin gave you.
login.errorMissingFields: Please enter your username and password.
login.errorLocked: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.errorDeactivated: This account has been deactivated. Please contact your barangay admin.
login.reasonTimeout: You were signed out after 8 hours of inactivity. Please log in again.
login.reasonDeactivated: This account has been deactivated. Please contact your barangay admin.

changePassword.heading: Set a new password
changePassword.body: This is your first time logging in — choose a new password before continuing.
changePassword.hint: At least 8 characters. No need for symbols or numbers — a longer phrase is fine.
changePassword.errorTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
changePassword.errorTooCommon: That password is too easy to guess. Please choose another one.
changePassword.errorNotAuthenticated: Your session expired. Please log in again.

consent.heading: Before you continue
consent.intro: BHW Connect collects some information about you and your work so it can serve your barangay. Please review before continuing.
consent.whatBody: Your name, contact details, barangay assignment, and how you use the app (e.g. questions you ask the Chat Guide).
consent.whyBody: To run your account, support your barangay health work, and improve the app.
consent.retentionBody: Usage data is kept for up to 24 months; account records are kept as required by law.
consent.rightsBody: You can ask your admin to show you your data or remove your account, per the Data Privacy Act.
